ui.completion_rule: accepted is durable command intake only; the UI displays completed only after the typed final entity and receipt are queryable

create_alert.compensation: disable or withdraw only the created draft alert fact

collect_pcap.compensation: cancel unsealed work and retain sealed evidence

verify_hash.compensation: none; append a superseding verification receipt

export_evidence.compensation: expire unpublished download grants and retain immutable audit

preserve_evidence.compensation: release only by a new authorized revision

associate_analysis.compensation: append unlink revision without deleting history

response_request.compensation: cancel undispatched handoff; external effects need provider compensation

invariants: tenant, actor, action, target, purpose, request hash and expected revision are frozen at acceptance
job, audit, history and outbox acceptance facts commit in one PostgreSQL transaction
same idempotency key and request returns the same job while a different request conflicts
accepted, recorded or HTTP 2xx never implies a completed alert, object, preservation hold, analysis link or external response
each action reaches a typed final entity or an explicit partial, failed, cancelled, compensated or expired state
consumer readiness and an immutable candidate digest are required before each dispatcher can be enabled
external response stays default-off and cannot perform traffic cleaning, blocking or blackhole routing in Topic 1
retry cannot duplicate the final entity or object and cannot erase an earlier provider receipt
domain.compensation: disable the affected dispatcher, stop new intake, finish or fail already accepted jobs under their frozen policy, preserve all authoritative facts and restore the legacy recorded-request adapter

data.migration: planned additive action_job, history, audit and outbox schema under T1-M09-N009/N016/N020; legacy audit-only endpoints remain until observed migration

negative_tests: the authenticated tenant cannot be replaced by a body, query or target tenant
an action is rejected when its exact action_authority scope is absent
requester and approver separation is enforced for preservation and external handoff when approval is required
a stale expected revision or conflicting idempotency payload creates no job, outbox or audit success
a disabled or unready executor fails closed without claiming a final entity

journeys: status polling through a final receipt
stop_conditions: duplicate final entities, outbox lag, unresolved partial jobs, stale status or acceptance P99 exceeds the approved candidate budget

tests: G0 action, final-entity, state, permission, migration and rollback contract
G1 PostgreSQL job, history, audit and outbox atomicity with idempotency and revision conflicts
G2 consumer-first readiness, broker ACK, offset and typed final receipt
G3 duplicate, cancel, retry, partial, compensation, expiry and cross-tenant negatives
G5 rollback and observation with legacy adapter compatibility
G6 Windows Chrome accepted-versus-final state recovery journey
evidence: candidate-bound request, job, audit, outbox, Kafka offset, executor receipt, final entity, compensation, rollback and browser state hashes
